text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock C and Stock D after gains reduced concentration, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; consider each position's role and risk.","Buying more Stock A and Stock E increased my exposure, so I should check diversification and cash needs before adding to positions.","One month of nearly flat account value after trading tells me little about whether those trades were good; judge decisions by a consistent plan, not short-term outcomes."]}
